Process Overview
Each complaint must be evaluated to determine reportability to regulatory authorities and notified
bodies as part of the complaint handling process. Activities related to reportability include evaluation
and reporting (shown below). The overall complaint handling process is addressed in 027-P043, Product
Complaint Handling and associated Work Instructions and includes regulatory reporting. This document
is specific to reportability. Requirements identified in this document are the responsibility of the
Formally Designated ComplaintHandling Unit Personnel including contractor and/or consultants
working for theComplaint Unit.

Appendix A –Aware Date vs. Notify Date Details
As noted in the Definitions Section above, Aware Date and Notify Date do not have the same definition.
The Aware Date and Notify may be the same dateor may differ.


The difference between the two terms, is that Aware Date represents the date that any Medtronic
Employee received sufficient information that necessitates a regulatory report.


In contrast, the NotifyDate represents the initial date that any MedtronicEmployee receives
information that meets the definition of a complaint.  Unless the initial Notify Date was erroneous, the
Notify Date for the event will not change.

In some situations, the initial information will meet the requirements for regulatory reporting, in which
case the Notify Date and the Aware Date will be the same date.  However, if the initial information
provided does not necessitate regulatory reporting, and new information is later received which does
require regulatory reporting, the Aware Date would be updated to align with the date in which the new
information (the information that requires a regulatory report) was received.


NOTE: Aware Date may be defined differently per local Country/Region requirements.  Please reference
the applicable local regulatory definitions for countries/regions per applicable work instructions in
Section 1.1; and this may also be represented in the file, with different aware dates for different
reporting decisions made based on different countries having different reportability criteria.
